Quota managed via global-biblio-base gateway with v3.9.0 billing rules (5 interfaces, 1 quota per successful call), restricted display when quota exhausted.
Production URL: read from global-biblio-base/config.json → SMARTLIB_GATEWAY_URL (SmartLib Gateway v52.1)
